section_summary.extract_value: This discussion section emphasizes the importance of positive body image, specifically body appreciation, as a protective factor against eating disorder symptoms. The current study (Study X) aimed to provide psychometric data for the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) using a sample of Black college women in the United States, addressing a gap in research that primarily focused on White women. Findings supported the reliability and validity of the BAS in this sample, showing a moderate, negative correlation between body appreciation and BMI, and a link between ethnic identity and body appreciation. The section also discusses limitations, including reliance on self-report measures and the use of a college sample, while highlighting implications for interventions.
